%% Hand-authored circuitikz figure -- NOT generated by maestro2tex, placed by it via
%% the `order` list in configs/anatop_tb_tia_amp_ab_corners.json. Topology transcribed
%% from the class-AB TIA amp bench netlists (Interactive.14, archived under
%% simarchive/tb_anatop_tia_amp_ab/tia_ab_2026-08-16/). Supplies, the bias rails and
%% En are omitted -- identical in every bench and carrying no measurement.
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \resizebox{0.56\linewidth}{!}{%
\ctikzset{bipoles/length=1.0cm, resistors/scale=0.85, capacitors/scale=0.85, sources/scale=0.85}
\begin{circuitikz}[
    every node/.append style={font=\footnotesize},
    nlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=1.5pt},
    opt/.style={font=\scriptsize, text=black!55, align=center, inner sep=2pt},
    railnode/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=1.05pt},
    prb/.style={draw, circle, minimum size=9pt, inner sep=0pt},
  ]
  \node[op amp] (A) at (0,0) {};
  \node at (A.center) {\footnotesize A2};
  %% Input pins leave horizontally; every branch that meets them is placed at the
  %% pin height with (x,0 |- pin) so no run is ever diagonal.
  \coordinate (Ap) at (A.+);
  \coordinate (Am) at (A.-);
  \coordinate (VCM) at (-1.6,0 |- Ap);
  \coordinate (FB)  at (-2.8,0 |- Am);
  \draw (A.+) -- (VCM);
  \draw (VCM) to[V, l_=$V_{\mathrm{CM}}$] (-1.6,-2.6) node[ground]{};
  \node[prb] (P) at (-1.6,2.2) {};
  \draw (A.-) -- (FB) -- (-2.8,2.2) -- (P.west);
  \node[nlab, above=2pt] at (P.north) {probe};
  \draw (P.east) -- (1.6,2.2) -- (1.6,0);
  \draw (A.out) -- (1.6,0);
  \node[railnode] at (1.6,0){};
  \node[nlab, below right] at (1.7,-0.05){$v_{\mathrm{out}}$};
  \draw (1.6,0) -- (2.9,0);
  \draw (2.9,0) to[C, l=$C_L$] (2.9,-2.6) node[ground]{};
  \draw (2.9,0) -- (4.4,0);
  \draw (4.4,0) to[I, l=$i_{\mathrm{load}}$] (4.4,-2.6) node[ground]{};
  \node[opt, anchor=north] at (4.4,-3.0) {drive sweep only};
  \node[opt, anchor=north] at (-1.6,-3.0) {DC source};
\end{circuitikz}
  }
  \caption[{Unity-feedback bench for the transimpedance amplifier.}]{Unity-feedback bench. The amplifier's output is returned to its inverting input through a current probe and loaded by $C_L = \SI{5}{\pico\farad}$; the loop-gain analysis through that probe gives the amplifier's own gain and margins, and DC and noise analyses on the same wiring give the offset and output noise. The drive measurement adds the swept load current $i_{\mathrm{load}}$ on the same schematic. Supplies, the bias rails and the enable pin are omitted here and in Figure~\ref{fig:tb-tiafb}.}
  \label{fig:tb-unityfb}
\end{figure}
